description: Source file implementing WebSocketEndpointLockManager class for managing endpoint locks with delay, including lock/unlock mechanisms, delay testing, and internal data structures.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager
classes.description: Manages locking and unlocking of WebSocket endpoints with delay, including internal lock info and waiter queue management.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::Waiter
classes.description: Represents a waiter waiting for endpoint lock.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::LockReleaser
classes.description: Handles releasing of endpoint lock, automatically unlocking on destruction.

classes.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::LockInfo
classes.description: Stores lock state and waiter queue for each endpoint.

methods.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::LockEndpoint
methods.description: Attempts to lock an endpoint; returns OK if successful or ERR_IO_PENDING if waiting.

methods.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::UnlockEndpoint
methods.description: Unlocks an endpoint and triggers delayed unlock process.

methods.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the lock manager has no active locks.

methods.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::SetUnlockDelayForTesting
methods.description: Sets delay duration for unlocking, used for testing.

methods.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::RegisterLockReleaser
methods.description: Associates a LockReleaser with an endpoint.

methods.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::UnlockEndpointAfterDelay
methods.description: Schedules delayed unlocking of an endpoint.

methods.name: WebSocketEndpointLockManager::DelayedUnlockEndpoint
methods.description: Performs the actual delayed unlock and activates next waiter if any.
